name: TachiyomiAZ
subtitle: The iOS build of TachiyomiAZ
description: TachiyomiAZ for iOS. Shares its library, history and tracking rules with the Android app, and runs the same TachiyomiX extensions through an embedded JVM.

apps.name: TachiyomiAZ
apps.subtitle: A manga reader that runs TachiyomiX extensions
apps.localizedDescription:
TachiyomiAZ for iOS.

The library, reading history, categories and tracking all live in the same database schema the Android app uses, so a backup restores on either. Sources are the same TachiyomiX JAR extensions, loaded into an embedded JVM rather than reimplemented.
